facts.fact: The WARDIP consultants' final report delivered a strategic plan for Guinea-Bissau's Universal Access and Service Fund (FAU), including fibre links extending the national backbone to less-served rural centres and a pilot to subsidise phones.
facts.system: Fundo de Acesso e Servico Universal (FAU)

systems.system: Fundo de Acesso e Servico Universal (FAU)

GNB.note: No budget amount, levy or spending stated.
A physical dissemination workshop only; no online channel.
Backbone expansion is a law commitment and a WARDIP project to come; no contract or works stated.

facts.fact: A dissemination workshop on 30 October 2025 presented Guinea-Bissau's draft universal access and service law, decree, policy and FAU plan to stakeholders, whose twelve comments the consultants answered in the final report.
